## The `bp` CLI manifest

Fetched via `bp capabilities -o json --full`: **24 nouns**, **142 total commands**. The noun with the most commands is **`doc`** (17 commands — documents, the content workhorse), narrowly ahead of `media` (16) and `task` (13).

## Top 5 ready tasks (`bp task ready`, priority-ordered)

There were **797 ready tasks total** (the default page caps at 50; `--all` paged through everything). All five below sit at the top priority tier (priority `0`).

1. **`bp-login-ux-w2-live-e2e`** — *Device-login loop witnessed live: real TTY + real browser on barkpark.cloud, evidence stamped.* Asks for proof, via a real terminal session and a real browser against the live control plane, that the `bp login` device-code flow works end-to-end (including throttling, scratch-config isolation, and post-login fleet handoff) — pure evidence-gathering, no code changes beyond committing screenshots. (7 of 8 criteria already met; the last is human-gated on a paid/provisioned fleet.)

2. **`task-96a908af98698118`** — *Felix pristine initiative — Phoenix mastery audit of `api/`.* A large parent audit tasking Felix-profile agents to compare Barkpark's Phoenix/Elixir code against the "Phoenix Mastery Corpus" domain-by-domain, only filing child fix-tasks where a change prevents a named failure, removes measured cost, or closes a real scar-class risk (no cosmetic churn).

3. **`gh-1`** — *GitHub App registration + credential wiring.* A human-gated task to register a GitHub App in GitHub's UI (Contents/Administration/Webhooks scopes) and wire its credentials into Barkpark, unblocking the cloud connect/deploy feature and downstream launch criteria.

4. **`bp-cloud-build-epic`** — *Perfect Plan BUILD — ship the readiness-ledger sequence into Barkpark Cloud.* The execution epic that turns the ratified "Perfect Plan readiness-ledger" design into shipped tenancy-layer product code — starting with a verified per-workspace export/import bundle and a quota/telemetry gate at the router.

5. **`task-e640bb01fca6ea38`** — *Barkpark Connectors — integrate agents with external services (epic).* An epic to make connecting a Barkpark agent to outside services (chat channels like Slack/Discord, and tool connectors like GitHub/Linear via MCP) a first-class, two-minute product action, built multi-tenant on a per-tenant sandboxed runner.

## Two manifest facts

- (a) There were roughly **797 ready tasks** in total.
- (b) **`doc`** carries the most commands in the manifest, with **17**.

No task or file state was modified — all commands run were read-only (`bp capabilities`, `bp task ready`, `bp task get`).
